title: POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/objects: result
description: A change saved for the next publish, as the Proxies page's Save saves it. Also the result of replacing and of removing an object.

stage.description: Code. saved: waiting for a publish.

removal.description: Value. True where the saved change removes the object.

changed.description: Value. False where the document already was what is saved or published and nothing was written.

revision.description: Value. The saved change's revision; send it as If-Match to replace exactly this. null where nothing is saved.

updated_by.description: Value. Who saved the change last, such as token:name for a token; null where nothing is saved.

updated_at.description: Value. When the change was saved; null where nothing is saved.

check.description: How the object fits its cluster, as the editor's check says it; null for a removal.

fits.description: Value. True where the object was generated beside the cluster's description without a refusal, false where it was refused, null where the cluster is not described well enough to judge.

problem.description: Text. The engine's sentence on why it does not fit; null where it does or cannot be judged. The change is saved all the same, as a draft is.

warnings.description: Text. Server names the manager cannot resolve; the nodes may.
